title: nOS — Loop (weakness, proposal, verdict, session)
description: The self-improvement loop as its tables record it. Companion to tools/loop-status.py and tools/agent-status.py, which answer the same questions in a terminal.

options.content:
**The self-improvement loop, from the tables that record it** — `loop_proposals` → `loop_judge_runs` → `loop_verdicts`, beside the `agent_sessions` that produced them.

Every panel is a `SELECT` against `wing.db`; nothing here is derived twice. Two questions it deliberately does **not** answer: *did a passing proposal reach the tree* (that is a git question — `tools/loop-status.py` owns the join, and a second implementation of it would be a second answer), and *is a chain any good* (no oracle in the estate scores that).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS proposals FROM loop_proposals
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS proposals FROM loop_proposals

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs FROM loop_judge_runs

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS verdicts FROM loop_verdicts

panels.title: Proposals naming no session
panels.description: The lineage gap. `nos-loop propose --session-uuid` shipped 2026-08-29; every proposal recorded BEFORE it carries NULL and always will. This trends to a constant, not to zero — a rising number means the runner stopped stamping.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(session_uuid IS NULL) AS nameless FROM loop_proposals
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(session_uuid IS NULL) AS nameless FROM loop_proposals

panels.title: Weakness -> proposal -> verdict -> the session that made it
panels.description: One row per (proposal, verdict). A proposal with two verdicts appears twice — that is the record, not a rendering bug: a re-seal is a fact.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT p.created_at AS at, p.weakness_id, p.intent_class, p.gate_set,
       COALESCE(v.result,'(unjudged)') AS verdict,
       COALESCE(s.agent_name,'(no session)') AS agent,
       COALESCE(s.outcome_result,'') AS agent_outcome
  FROM loop_proposals p
  LEFT JOIN loop_verdicts v ON v.proposal_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN agent_sessions s ON s.uuid = p.session_uuid
 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 40
targets.queryText:

 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Judges: what each one actually did
panels.description: `least_work_seen` beside `ratchet` is the panel worth reading: a judge whose smallest observed work count is near its floor is one silent scope loss away from passing on nothing.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT judge_name,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       SUM(outcome='pass') AS pass,
       SUM(outcome='fail') AS fail,
       SUM(outcome NOT IN ('pass','fail')) AS indeterminate,
       MIN(work_count) AS least_work_seen,
       MAX(min_work) AS ratchet
  FROM loop_judge_runs GROUP BY judge_name ORDER BY runs DESC
targets.queryText:
SELECT judge_name,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       SUM(outcome='pass') AS pass,
       SUM(outcome='fail') AS fail,
       SUM(outcome NOT IN ('pass','fail')) AS indeterminate,
       MIN(work_count) AS least_work_seen,
       MAX(min_work) AS ratchet
  FROM loop_judge_runs GROUP BY judge_name ORDER BY runs DESC

options.content: **The runs behind the proposals.** `outcome_result` is the verdict an oracle wrote; `status` only says the process ended.

panels.title: Sessions by agent, scored on the OUTCOME and not on having finished
panels.description: `ended_with_no_verdict` is the column this dashboard exists for. A run that stopped without an oracle saying anything is not a success, and any panel that counts `status='idle'` as one is reporting the process, not the work.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT agent_name,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       SUM(outcome_result='satisfied') AS satisfied,
       SUM(outcome_result='needs_revision') AS needs_revision,
       SUM(outcome_result IS NULL AND ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS ended_with_no_verdict,
       SUM(ended_at IS NULL) AS still_open,
       SUM(COALESCE(tokens_input,0)+COALESCE(tokens_output,0)) AS tokens
  FROM agent_sessions GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY runs DESC
targets.queryText:
SELECT agent_name,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       SUM(outcome_result='satisfied') AS satisfied,
       SUM(outcome_result='needs_revision') AS needs_revision,
       SUM(outcome_result IS NULL AND ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS ended_with_no_verdict,
       SUM(ended_at IS NULL) AS still_open,
       SUM(COALESCE(tokens_input,0)+COALESCE(tokens_output,0)) AS tokens
  FROM agent_sessions GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Iterations — where a run spent its turns

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT i.session_uuid, s.agent_name, i.iteration, i.grader_result,
       i.tokens_input, i.tokens_output, i.duration_ms, i.created_at
  FROM agent_iterations i LEFT JOIN agent_sessions s ON s.uuid = i.session_uuid
 ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Open questions — what is waiting on a person
panels.description: Empty is the good state and is not the same as 'no agent ever asked'.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT created_at, agent_name, severity, substr(prompt,1,110) AS asked
  FROM agent_questions WHERE answered_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
